goal: Expand the existing service page only where search evidence and the current page state justify substantive additions.

seo_evidence.note: The page is already in search. Treat weekly movement as a signal to inspect content, not as proof that a rewrite is required.

instructions: Find and read the current target service through codex/scripts/wp before proposing changes.
Read current SEO metadata for the target object.
Check nearby service pages for duplication/cannibalization before adding content.
Preserve the existing commercial intent and URL.
Prefer substantive additions based on real service details, process, constraints, examples, pricing/engagement model or FAQ where justified.
Do not make a cosmetic rewrite merely to increase word count.
Prepare a diagnosis and concrete before/after proposal. Do not publish automatically.
acceptance_criteria: Stay within the approved WP_CONTENT scope.
Do not change slug, canonical, redirects or template code.
Use current WordPress data as the source of truth.
Return NO_CHANGE if no safe substantive improvement is justified.
Record a verification checklist for later SEO monitoring.
